adConsentTitle.zu: Izikhangiso zenza le app ibe mahhala
adConsentTitle.st: Dipapatso di etsa hore app ena e be mahala

adConsentBody.en: Google shows the ads here. Say yes and it may use cookies to pick ads for you. Say no and you still get ads, just not picked for you. Change your mind any time in Settings.
adConsentBody.af: Google wys die advertensies hier. Sê ja, en dit mag koekies gebruik om advertensies vir jou te kies. Sê nee, en jy kry steeds advertensies, net nie vir jou gekies nie. Jy kan enige tyd in Instellings van plan verander.
adConsentBody.zu: UGoogle ukhombisa izikhangiso lapha. Uma uthi yebo, angasebenzisa ama-cookie ukukukhethela izikhangiso. Uma uthi cha, usazobona izikhangiso, kodwa hhayi ezikhethelwe wena. Ungashintsha umqondo noma nini ezilungiselelweni.
adConsentBody.xh: UGoogle ubonisa iintengiso apha. Ukuba uthi ewe, angasebenzisa ii-cookie ukukukhethela iintengiso. Ukuba uthi hayi, usazozifumana iintengiso, kodwa ezingakhethwanga wena. Ungatshintsha ingqondo nanini na kwiiSetingi.
adConsentBody.st: Google e bontsha dipapatso mona. Ha o re e, e ka sebedisa di-cookie ho o kgethela dipapatso. Ha o re tjhe, o tla ntse o fumana dipapatso, empa di sa kgethelwa wena. O ka fetola maikutlo neng kapa neng ho Ditlhophiso.

adConsentGeneral.st: Tjhe, di tlohele e le tsa kakaretso
